MINUTES
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  FEBRUARY 11, 2020

A regular meeting of the City Council of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order by
MAYOR SCHMITZ at 7:00 p.m. in the Council Chamber at Rolling Hills Estates City Hall, 4045
Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Point Vicente Elementary School’s Student Council Officers led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan, Zuckerman

City Council Members Absent:  None.

City Staff Present: City Manager Greg Grammer
  Assistant City Manager Alexa Davis
  City Attorney Don Davis
  Community Development/Public Works Director David Wahba
  City Clerk Lauren Pettit

CEREMONIAL ITEMS

NONE.

CONSENT CALENDAR

  The following routine matters will be acted upon by one vote to approve with the majority consent of
  the City Council. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless good cause is shown
  by a member prior to the roll call vote. (Items removed for individual consideration will be voted on
  separately.)

  COUNCIL MEMBER MITCHELL moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF,

  THAT THE CITY COUNCIL APPROVE CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS A-F AS
  PRESENTED BELOW.

  AYES:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan and Zuckerman
  ABSENT:  None

A.  READING OF ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS BY TITLE ONLY

  APPROVED.

B.  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES OF JANUARY 28, 2020

  APPROVED.

C.  DEMANDS AND WARRANTS - FEBRUARY 2020

  APPROVED WARRANTS 62429 THROUGH 62457 IN THE AMOUNT OF
  $269,745.01 AND SUPPLEMENTAL WARRANTS 010720; 020120 THROUGH
  020420 IN THE AMOUNT OF $355,367.47 FOR THE GRAND TOTAL AMOUNT
  OF $625,112.48 WITH PROPER AUDIT.

D.  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES, JANUARY 21, 2020

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

E.  EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE MEETING MINUTES, JANUARY 27, 2020

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  1
FEBRUARY 11, 2020
 F.  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES, FEBRUARY 3, 2020

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

PUBLIC COMMENT / PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS

NONE.

PUBLIC HEARINGS

NONE.

NEW BUSINESS
NONE.

OLD BUSINESS

A.  CONTRACT AMENDMENT - CLUB VIEW LANE STORMDRAIN REPAIR PROJECT

  Recommendation: That the City Council approve an amendment to the existing Public
  Works Contract with E.C. Construction to add $24,850, plus a 20% contingency of $4,970
  to complete the storm drain repairs on Club View Lane, for an additional total project cost
  of $29,820.

  Director of Community Development and Public Works David Wahba provided a staff
  report (as per the agenda material).

  In response to COUNCIL MEMBER MITCHELL, the Director of Community Development
  and Public Works confirmed there should be no more unexpected issues with this project.
  MAYOR PRO TEM ZUCKERMAN inquired about specifications or drawings associated
  with the additional work. The Director of Community Development and Public Works
  stated that plans were not necessary and this was a way to save on costs.

  MAYOR PRO TEM ZUCKERMAN confirmed with staff that this amendment would not
  require recordation of any new easements.

  MAYOR PRO TEM ZUKERMAN moved, seconded by, COUNCIL MEMBER MITCHELL,

  THAT THE CITY COUNCIL APPROVE AN AMENDMENT TO THE EXISTING
  PUBLIC WORKS CONTRACT WITH E.C. CONSTRUCTION TO ADD $24,850,
  PLUS A 20% CONTINGENCY OF $4,970 TO COMPLETE THE STORM DRAIN
  REPAIRS ON CLUB VIEW LANE, FOR AN ADDITIONAL TOTAL PROJECT
  COST OF $29,820.

  AYES:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan and Zuckerman
  ABSENT:  None

CITY ATTORNEY ITEMS

CITY ATTORNEY DAVIS noted for the record that the Council met in closed session during the
noticed joint meeting that took place at 5:30 p.m. on the same day, and the Council took no
reportable action.

CITY COUNCIL/REGIONAL COMMITTEE REPORTS:

COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF, as the City’s delegate to the League of California Cities Los Angeles
Division, announced that there will be a Media and Communications training on Wednesday,
February 13, 2020 in San Gabriel. She also provided an update on the LA Division’s work to
defeat SB50.

COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF also reported that registration is now open for the South Bay Council
of Governments’ General Assembly, being held on Thursday, March 19, 2020.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  2
FEBRUARY 11, 2020
 COUNCIL MEMBER MITCHELL attended the Regional Council meeting for the Southern
California Association of Governments, and provided a brief update on the High Speed Rail
Project. COUNCIL MEMBER MITCHELL also provided an update on the SCAG’s potential
revote regarding the Regional Housing Needs Assessment.

COUNCIL MEMBER MITCHELL provided information on the Orange County Transportation
Authority’s purchase of ten hydrogen-fueled buses, as well as the installation of the nation’s
largest hydrogen fueling station.

COUNCIL MEMBER MITCHELL also reported that the Air Quality Management District recently
pulled bill SB732, involving the establishment of a Voter Authorization District in the South Coast
basin for an initiative to pass a sales tax which would have funded incentives to turn over the
transportation fleets over time. AQMD will be exploring other potential avenues to fund this
turnover of the fleets in the future.

COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN, as a member of Southern California Association of
Governments’ Technology Committee, visited and toured SpaceX’s high-speed tunnel where
they discussed potential future transportation solutions.

COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN announced the upcoming USC Forum for Local Leaders
Sustainability Summit which will be held in Palm Springs on February 21-22, 2020.

COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN also reported on his recent trip to Xalapa, Mexico where he
taught a two-day course for law students at Anáhuac University.

MAYOR PRO TEM ZUCKERMAN attended the Los Angeles County Supervisor’s meeting this
morning and accepted the 2019 Champion for West Nile Virus Prevention Award on behalf of
the City. Rolling Hills Estates was one of 10 cities that received this award.

MAYOR AND COUNCIL ITEMS:

  This item provides the opportunity for Members of the City Council to request information on currently
  pending projects and/or issues of public concern, direct that an item be agendized for future
  consideration and/or make announcements of interest to the public.

A.  REQUEST TO ATTEND CALIFORNIA ASSOCIATION OF COUNCIL  OF
  GOVERNMENTS: REGIONAL LEADERSHIP FORUM - APRIL 5-7, 2020

  CONSENSUS OF COUNCIL TO AUTHORIZE ANY COUNCIL MEMBER WHO
  WISHES TO ATTEND THIS FORUM.

OTHER MAYOR AND COUNCIL ITEMS:

MAYOR SCHMITZ introduced City Clerk Lauren Pettit, Rolling Hills Estates’ newest employee.

CLOSED SESSION

NONE.

ADJOURNMENT

At 7:35 p.m. MAYOR SCHMITZ adjourned the City Council meeting. The next regular City
Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, February 25, 2020 at 7:00 p.m. in the Council Chamber
at Rolling Hills Estates City Hall, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California.
Submitted by,  Approved by,

Lauren Pettit  Greg Grammer
City Clerk  City Manager

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  3
FEBRUARY 11, 2020
